李老屯话音落下，李三奎的脸上顿时流露出委屈之色，这些野物都是自家儿子打的，凭什么不给青山吃上一只野鸡？

但是。

面对李老屯的权威，李三奎却不敢反驳。

这是长年累月之下，长期积累出来的服从性，不敢反抗。

“李老屯，这些野物都是我李青山打到的，凭什么要交给你处置？”

李青山轻笑一声，语气中夹杂着几分不悦反驳道。

“啪！”

李青山话音落下，便见李老屯猛然拍桌而起，怒目圆瞪，狠狠的盯着李青山道：“小崽子，你要翻了天不是？”

“我是一家之主，这个家是我说了算！”

“你打到的野物，就是这个家的野物，自然是由我来分配！”

“李三奎，看看你养的好儿子啊！”

“竟然还敢以下犯上了！”

“不孝，真是不孝啊……！”

李老屯话音落下，李三奎被训斥的面色煞白，不知道该如何回答父亲的责骂。

“李老屯，现在是民主，你还在这搞专权？”

“我看你是不想好了啊？”

李青山眼神中流露出一抹不屑，继续道：“天王老子来了，这野物也是我打的，你们谁也分配不了！”

“谁他娘的敢动老子的野物一下。”

“姥姥的。”

“嘭！”

下一秒。

李青山手中的柴刀便狠狠劈在木头桌子上，只听得一道沉闷声响，木屑飞舞，厚实的木头桌子直接被劈开一个大口子，力道十足，巨大的声响吓得旁边李青有和李青余浑身打了个哆嗦。

就连一向是在家中横行霸道的李老屯，望着眼前发飙的狼崽子。

也是被吓得微微一怔。

其他村民纷纷对视一眼，面露复杂之色，这个李青山好像和以前，不太一样了啊！

怎么这么硬气？

“李青山，你要干什么？还打算动手不成？”李二奎在家中脾气最为暴躁，被李青山吓得缓和过来后，当即开口怒斥道：“老三，看看你养的什么好儿子，真是个二流子。”

“我……！”

李三奎眉头紧皱，目光朝着李青山望了一眼，无奈道：“青山，不要胡来……！”

“二伯，你是长辈，我不能对你动手！”

“对吧！”

李青山冷笑一声，目光看向李二奎道。

“哼，你小子还知道我是你长辈？”

“刚刚是怎么和你爷说话的？赶紧给你爷道歉！”

李二奎对李青山的话，颇为受用道。

“二伯，你理解错我的意思了！”

“你是长辈，我对你动手不太好，但是你两个儿子和我是平辈，我揍他们，没问题吧？”

李青山认真道。

‘什么？’

李二奎听到李青山的话后，微微一怔，一时间有些没反应过来。

不是，这是什么脑回路？

李青有和李青余也是一脸懵逼，李青山这货是怎么想的？

然而。

还未等到李二奎反应过来，李青山便已经冲上去了，一拳落在李青有的小腹，撕裂般的剧痛传来，李青有当即捂着小腹蹲倒在地上，面目扭曲，脸上满是痛苦之色。

“喂，你……！”

李青余见状，也还没来得及反应，李青山已经到了面前抓住一条胳膊，直接一个过肩摔。

“啪……！”

又是一道沉闷声响，李青余哎呦的惨叫一声，倒在地上和他哥哥一起痛苦惨叫。

老李家的人望着眼前这一幕，脸上的眼神被吓得煞白。

解决掉这两个经常冷嘲热讽自己，仗着兄弟二人欺负自己的家伙后，李青山直接一个侧身上前，一脚朝着李青书踹了过去。

“嘭……！”

又是一道沉闷的声响。

李青书的胸口顿时出现一个大脚印子，整个人直接被李青山踹飞了出去。

没多。

一百多斤的人，直接被踹飞了。

“哎呦……！”

“李青山，你小子竟敢偷袭，粗鲁……实在粗鲁……哎呦，疼死我了……要不是我是个知识分子，动手有辱斯文，一定动手打死你……！”

李青书倒在地上捂着胸口惨叫着，面目都扭曲了。

李青山一人放倒三人。

而且一气呵成，电光火石之间便完成了这一幕。

“我滴乖乖，青山这小子好身手啊，哪里学来的？”

“不是李青山身手好，是李青有，李青余和李青书三个人太废物了。”

“李青山这二流子胆子还真是够大的，敢下这么狠的手，就不怕李老屯把他赶出去？”、

“我倒是觉得，李青山这小子好像有点不一样了！”

周围村民们见状，议论纷纷，指指点点道。

“李青山，你敢打我儿？”

李二奎望着躺在地上的两个儿子，顿时感觉心痛无比，就要上前对李青山动手，便见一道如小山一般的身影挡在前面道：“你敢动我山哥试试，看我不锤死你的。”

来人正是大壮！

“大哥，还有我！”

“谁敢动山哥，我垂死他！”

大壮和二壮这两个家伙朝着这边一站，压迫感十足，顿时让李二奎停了下来，面露尴尬。

After Li Laotun finished speaking, Li Sankui's face suddenly showed a look of grievance. These wild animals were hunted by his own son. Why not give Qingshan a pheasant to eat?

but.

Facing Li Laotun's authority, Li Sankui did not dare to refute.

This is the obedience accumulated over many years, and I dare not resist.

"Li Laotun, I, Li Qingshan, hunted these wild animals, why should I leave them to you?"

Li Qingshan chuckled and retorted with a hint of displeasure in his tone.

"Crack!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he saw Li Laotun suddenly slapped the table and stood up. He stared at Li Qingshan with an angry look and said: "Little brat, you are going to turn the world upside down, aren't you?"

"I am the head of the family, and I have the final say in this family!"

"The wild animals you hunt are the wild animals of this family, so naturally I will distribute them!"

"Li Sankui, look at the good son you raised!"

"How dare you do the following!"

"Unfilial, really unfilial...!"

After Li Laotun finished speaking, Li Sankui's face turned pale after being scolded, and he didn't know how to answer his father's scolding.

"Li Laotun, this is democracy, are you still exercising dictatorship here?"

"I take it you don't think about it anymore?"

There was a hint of disdain in Li Qingshan's eyes, and he continued: "Heavenly King is here. I also killed this beast, and none of you can distribute it!"

"Who the hell dares to touch my wild animal?"

"Grandma's."

"Bang!"

The next second.

The hatchet in Li Qingshan's hand struck the wooden table hard, and a dull sound was heard, sawdust flew, and a large hole was opened in the thick wooden table. The force was so strong that the loud sound scared Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu next to them and trembled.

Even Li Laotun, who had always been domineering at home, looked at the furious wolf cub in front of him.

He was also slightly startled by the fright.

The other villagers looked at each other with complicated expressions on their faces. This Li Qingshan seemed different from before!

Why are you so tough?

"Li Qingshan, what are you going to do? Are you still planning to take action?" Li Erkui had the most violent temper at home. After being frightened by Li Qingshan, he calmed down and immediately shouted angrily: "Third brother, look at what a good son you have raised. He is really a second-rate son."

"I...!"

Li Sankui frowned, glanced at Li Qingshan, and said helplessly: "Qingshan, don't do this nonsense...!"

"Second uncle, you are the elder, I can't do anything to you!"

"Right!"

Li Qingshan sneered and looked at Li Erkui.

"Humph, you kid still knows that I am your elder?"

"Why did you talk to your father just now? Apologize to your father right now!"

Li Erkui was quite impressed by Li Qingshan's words.

"Second uncle, you misunderstood what I meant!"

"You are an elder, so it would be inappropriate for me to do anything to you, but your two sons are my equals. Is it okay for me to beat them up?"

Li Qingshan said seriously.

'What?’

After Li Erkui heard Li Qingshan's words, he was slightly startled and couldn't react for a while.

No, what kind of brain circuit is this?

Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu were also confused. What did Li Qingshan think?

However.

Before Li Erkui could react, Li Qingshan had already rushed forward and landed a punch on Li Qingyou's lower abdomen. A sharp tearing pain was felt. Li Qingyou immediately covered his lower abdomen and squatted on the ground, his face twisted and full of pain.

"Hey, you...!"

When Li Qingyu saw this, before he could react, Li Qingshan was already in front of him, grabbed an arm, and threw him over his shoulder.

"Pah...!"

There was another dull sound, and Li Qingyu screamed, falling to the ground and screaming in pain together with his brother.

The people of Lao Li's family looked at the scene in front of them, their faces turned pale with fright.

After getting rid of these two guys who often ridiculed him and relied on the two brothers to bully him, Li Qingshan stepped forward and kicked Li Qingshu.

"Bang...!"

There was another dull sound.

A big footprint suddenly appeared on Li Qingshu's chest, and he was kicked out by Li Qingshan.

Not much.

The man who weighed more than 100 kilograms was kicked away.

"Ouch...!"

"Li Qingshan, you dare to sneak attack, you are rude... you are really rude... oh, it hurts me so much... If I hadn't been an intellectual and it was so disrespectful to me, I would have beaten you to death...!"

Li Qingshu fell to the ground, clutching his chest and screaming, his face distorted.

Li Qingshan knocked down three people alone.

And it was done in one go, and the scene was completed in a flash.

"My dear, this boy Qingshan is so skilled. Where did he learn it?"

"It's not Li Qingshan who is good, it's Li Qingyou. Li Qingyu and Li Qingshu are too useless."

"Li Qingshan, a second-rate idiot, is really brave enough. If he dares to do something so cruel, aren't he afraid that Li Laotun will kick him out?"

"I think Li Qingshan is a little different!"

Seeing this, the surrounding villagers started talking and pointing.

"Li Qingshan, do you dare to hit my son?"

Li Erkui looked at his two sons lying on the ground, and suddenly felt extremely heartbroken. He was about to step forward to attack Li Qingshan, when he saw a figure like a hill standing in front of him and said, "If you dare to touch my brother Shan, try and see if I don't beat you to death."

The person coming is none other than Da Zhuang!

"Brother, there's me too!"

"Whoever dares to touch Brother Shan, I will kill him!"

The two guys, Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang, stood towards this side, feeling so oppressive that Li Erkui immediately stopped and looked embarrassed.
